tasks.subject: Bump version to 0.6.0
tasks.description: package.json version 0.5.4 -> 0.6.0. CHANGELOG: add '## [0.6.0] - 2026-08-28' section (move [Unreleased] content under it, leave empty [Unreleased] at top).

tasks.subject: Rebuild dist + verify check:dist/imports
tasks.description: Run nub run build, verify dist reflects new version + new exports (createMemorySessionStore, createMemoryRefreshTokenStore, SecurityScheme). Run nub run check:dist after staging dist. Verify consumer import resolves via node -e import('./dist/index.js').

tasks.subject: Commit the release
tasks.description: Stage package.json, CHANGELOG, README, AGENTS, docs/, src/, examples/, dist/ (never .scratch/.pi). Commit with a descriptive release message.

tasks.subject: Tag, push, create GH release
tasks.description: Create annotated tag v0.6.0, push master + tag to origin, create GitHub release via gh release create with notes.
